body:
Track 9, milestone 5 (`osrobot-field`). Stdlib simulation of a lane-following weeding robot: inline treat vs scout-then-tour, speed, lane overlap, sensor quality, false alarms, mud.

Headline (all from `experiments/results.txt`): scouting kills the same share as inline (0.399 vs 0.401) and is slower in all 23 paired rows; overlap 0 to 0.75 raises kill 0.40 to 0.86 at 3.5x the time. Stylised, constants assumed, sensitivity to the blur constant reported.

Checks: 7 unit tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
